title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish made with lamb mince, spices, and dried fruits.

ingredients.name: Yummy
ingredients.notes: Yummy spice blend (ground cumin, coriander, cinnamon, ginger)

ingredients.name: Midnite
ingredients.notes: Midnite spice blend (ground cinnamon, allspice, cardamom)

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian Spice
ingredients.notes: Saudi Arabian spice blend (ground cumin, coriander, cinnamon)

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add yummy, midnite, craving, saudi, and arabian spice blends and cook for 1 minute.
Add dried fruits and stir to combine.
Add 500ml of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
